length_of.description: pointer difference measuring the byte length after a UTF-8 character scan

character_count_bound.description: integer precision bound controlling the number of logical characters scanned

iterator_advance.description: macro/function that advances a byte pointer past one UTF-8 character; may advance 1-4 bytes

output_length.description: signed int variable that receives the measured byte length for later append/copy

narrowing_cast.description: C integer cast that narrows the pointer difference to signed int

safe_cap.description: macro/function that clamps a value to a safe maximum before narrowing

buffer_append.description: function that appends a bounded byte buffer to an output accumulator using a signed int length
